subject: Trial orchestration: scheduling hands-on POC + quota coordination
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@clearline.health>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@clearline.health>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Hands-on POC & capacity discussion — Clearline trial

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We would like to schedule a hands-on POC session that combines: a live prompt review, routing configuration walkthrough, and a short load test to validate token budgets. Our goals are to evaluate:

- Which model/quantization profile meets our latency and cost targets
- Routing fallbacks between Hosted and Dedicated for peak hours
- Token budget planning for our expected 2M tokens/day peak

Ideal windows: week of Nov 8 — we can do either Tue 11/9 between 10:00-11:30 PT or Wed 11/10 14:00-15:30 PT. We also need to surface procurement questions around a temporary quota bump for the load test and a short note on SLA for Dedicated.

Attaching our POC requirements doc for context.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Integrations
Clearline Health
Attachments: Clearline_POC_requirements.pdf
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearline.health>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on POC & capacity discussion — Clearline trial

Hi Samira,

Appreciate the detail and the doc — looks good. We can definitely run a combined session (prompt review, routing, and a short load test). Proposed agenda (45-75 minutes):

1) 10 min — Introductions & success criteria
2) 25 min — Prompt review + live prompt crafting (Marissa lead)
3) 20 min — Routing / model selection tradeoffs (Laura lead)
4) 15 min — Load test plan + token budget & quota ops (Rishi lead)

I can do Tue 11/9 10:00 PT or Wed 11/10 14:00 PT. If you prefer the 11/10 slot we will provision a short-lived quota bump for the load test and run a small staged load (Rishi will limit to defined test windows). For Dedicated vs Hosted: we typically recommend starting on Hosted for proof of quality and quick iteration, then switch to Dedicated if you need committed throughput and an SLA. I will surface specifics (token limits, expected burst behavior, and pricing delta) in a pre-call checklist.

Action items for you before the call:
- Confirm preferred slot and attendee list (especially compliance / procurement if they want to join)
- Confirm expected peak token/day (you mentioned ~2M)

Linking our HubSpot trial record here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/clearline-health
Attaching a short precall checklist.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0199
Attachments: redwood_precall_checklist.pdf
From: Samira Khan <samira@clearline.health>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@clearline.health>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on POC & capacity discussion — Clearline trial

Thanks Vivek — Wed 11/10 14:00 PT works best for our team. We'll have two people from Compliance join for the SLA/retention question set (they wanted to review before the call).

A couple of clarifying items so your team can prepare:
- Confirm whether a Hosted trial with a quota bump can realistically simulate our 2M token/day peak for 1-2 days, or whether we should provision Dedicated for the load test.
- If we stay Hosted for the POC, can Redwood guarantee the temporary quota bump will be isolated to our trial and reverted automatically?
- Procurement: can you share a ballpark price delta between a short Dedicated commit (one-month) vs Hosted billed consumption for the expected load?

I attached a short spreadsheet with compliance questions. Looking forward to the checklist and agenda.

Best,
Samira
Attachments: compliance_questions.xlsx
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearline.health>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.inference>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.inference>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Hands-on POC & capacity discussion — Clearline trial

Perfect — Wed 11/10 14:00 PT is locked. I sent a calendar invite to the confirmed attendees (link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-clearline-poc).

Quick answers and owners for the call: 
- Quota bump for load test: we can provision a scoped, time-boxed quota bump on Hosted to simulate 2M tokens/day for the test window. Rishi will coordinate the test window and rollback. (Owner: rishi_malhotra)
- Hosted vs Dedicated recommendation: start Hosted for the hands-on run to avoid provisioning lag; if the load test shows sustained peaks that exceed our cost/latency targets, we will discuss a short Dedicated commit. Laura will bring sample latency/cost numbers for both paths. (Owner: laura_bennett)
- Procurement/price delta: I will follow up with a one-page estimate in the next 24 hours (Owner: vivek_kulkarni / commercial team).

Pre-call asks (please send by EOD Mon 11/8):
- Final attendee list and their roles (procurement / compliance / engineering)
- Any specific prompts or eval prompts you want Marissa to include in the hands-on section

Attachments: redwood_precall_checklist.pdf
